model: ADAC 1000 deaerator / surge tank control (ProtoNode, EtherNet/IP)
equipment_type: Boiler feedwater deaerator and surge tank controller via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Cleaver-Brooks deaerator and surge tank packages with the ADAC 1000 PLC control, read through a ProtoNode RER gateway over EtherNet/IP.
summary: The ProtoNode maps the ADAC 1000 control to BACnet over EtherNet/IP: deaerator and surge tank pressure, temperature and level, valve signals, feedwater header pressure and setpoint, pump run times, lead/lag order and faults, plus a BMS heartbeat. Writable objects set pump lead/lag order and the feedwater header pressure setpoint.
notes: Each Cleaver-Brooks controller on the ProtoNode is its own BACnet device; the object instances below are the same on every device.
Access follows the guide's write-point stars: the starred AV/BV objects are writable, everything else is read-only.
The guide gives no engineering units or state texts; units appear only where the object name carries them (DEG F / DEG C).
Where a description is filled in, it gives the register from the guide's Modbus column.
The ProtoNode reads this profile from the PLC over EtherNet/IP.
Objects named DAWB[..], DAWI[..], DAWR[..], DAR1[..] or DAI1[..] are spare tags with no stated use.

source.title: Cloud Enabled ProtoNode Gateway Startup Guide (RER/LER) for interfacing Cleaver-Brooks products

integration.summary: Keep the BV 1 heartbeat updated and write the feedwater header pressure setpoint if the BMS owns it. Read deaerator pressure, level and temperature, header pressure and the no-alarm relays and heartbeat fault.
integration.heartbeat: BV 1 BMS Heartbeat bit is written by the BMS and BI 47 BMS Heartbeat Fault reports a loss; the guide does not state the timeout.
setup: BACnet Device Instance = the controller's Modbus Node-ID + Node_Offset (default 50,000), so Node-ID 1 = 50001. Change Node_Offset in the ProtoNode web configurator to pick other instances.
The ProtoNode RER does BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP, selected on its S bank DIP switches.
BACnet MS/TP: one MAC address (1-127) for the whole ProtoNode on the A bank DIP switches; baud on B0-B3 (38400 factory default).
BACnet IP: default ProtoNode address 192.168.1.24; change it in the web configurator.
